description: North star: every record carries (lat,lon,timestamp,source_url,license) so the corpus renders on a 3D globe with a time slider. Per-endpoint feed402 tiers: raw CSV $0.010, structured query $0.005, AI insight $0.002. Each child = one domain. DoD per child: (1) source+license audit, (2) ingestion script landing CSV in gdrive:AGFarms/Nucleus/research/<domain>-canon/, (3) x402 endpoint live on Base Sepolia via x402-research-gateway, (4) feed402 manifest, (5) sample globe viz frame. Every dataset must expose feed402 'insight' tier so AI agents pay-per-query.
title: EPIC: Globe-visualizable historical + live datasets for feed402 + x402-research-gateway
